sourceDescription: Media swipe app — dev server on the host

actions.title: Dev Server
actions.description: Next.js dev server on host (PM2-supervised, scale-to-zero)
actions.info: Served at https://dev-server.messer.wtf. Port 3000 is shared with the other projects' dev servers, so starting this one stops whatever else occupies it — one dev server at a time by design. Runs on the macOS host under PM2 as messer-swipe-dev (host node_modules, Next 16 Turbopack); Stop deletes the PM2 app, and an idle watchdog scales it to zero after ~15 min without activity. Uses the repo's own .env (PROVIDER, AUTH_SECRET) and the local swiparr.db, with JELLYFIN_URL overridden to the host-reachable jellyfin.orb.local:8096 — the .env value jellyfin:8096 is Docker-internal and unresolvable from the host, which made every login fail with "Server connection failed".
actions.confirmMessage: Start the Messer Swipe dev server on host? Served at https://dev-server.messer.wtf — this stops any other project's dev server on port 3000.
actions.stopConfirmMessage: Stop the Messer Swipe dev server? Deletes its PM2 app and kills the process.

status_command.title: Check dev server PM2 app
status_command.description: PM2 app messer-swipe-dev has a live pid.
status_command.command: pid=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 pid messer-swipe-dev 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ "$pid" != "0" ]; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi

commands.title: Stop existing dev servers
commands.description: Single dev server across all projects.
commands.info: Deletes dev PM2 apps (incl. legacy names and the swipe idle watchdog), kills dev ports 3000/3001/8000/4321/4322/8898, removes the stale Next dev lock, and reaps stray host dev processes (dev-stray-guard --sweep).
commands.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 delete messer-swipe-dev messer-swipe-dev-watch site-dev site-dev-watch site-dev-heal site-studio-dev messer-notes-dev messer-notes-dev-watch portal-dev portal-dev-watch gallery-dev gallery-dev-watch 2>/dev/null || true; for p in 3000 3001 8000 4321 4322 8898; do lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; done; rm -f /Users/jakob/Repos/messer-swipe/.next/dev/lock; sleep 1; /usr/bin/python3 /Users/jakob/Scripts/dev-stray-guard.py --sweep; echo 'cleaned — dev PM2 apps stopped, ports 3000/3001/8000 freed, stray dev processes reaped'

commands.title: Start supervised dev server
commands.description: PM2 with an idle scale-to-zero watchdog; provider URL pointed at the host-reachable Jellyfin.
commands.info: run-dev.sh cds into the repo and execs next dev, so PM2 tracks the real server. dev-idle-watch.py stops it after 15 min idle. The repo .env carries JELLYFIN_URL=http://jellyfin:8096, a Docker-internal name that does NOT resolve on the macOS host (login fails with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND jellyfin), so this step overrides it with the OrbStack hostname jellyfin.orb.local:8096 — env wins over .env in Next. JELLYFIN_PUBLIC_URL is overridden too because .env still points it at the retired watch.messerstudios.dev.
commands.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 start /Users/jakob/Scripts/run-dev.sh --name messer-swipe-dev --no-autorestart -- /Users/jakob/Repos/messer-swipe env JELLYFIN_URL=http://jellyfin.orb.local:8096 JELLYFIN_PUBLIC_URL=https://watch.messer.wtf ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --port 3000 --hostname 0.0.0.0 >/dev/null; /opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 start /Users/jakob/Scripts/dev-idle-watch.py --name messer-swipe-dev-watch --no-autorestart -- --pm2-name messer-swipe-dev --repo /Users/jakob/Repos/messer-swipe --port 3000 --idle 15 --pm2 /opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 >/dev/null; sleep 2; echo 'started under PM2 — messer-swipe-dev + idle watchdog'

commands.title: Wait for dev server
commands.description: Poll /login until ready; fail fast if the process died.
commands.command: for i in $(seq 1 45); do pid=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 pid messer-swipe-dev 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ "$pid" = "0" ]; then echo 'dev server died at startup — tail of the error log:'; tail -20 /Users/jakob/.pm2/logs/messer-swipe-dev-error.log 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; curl -sf -H 'Host: dev-server.messer.wtf' http://127.0.0.1:3000/login >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo 'dev server ready — https://dev-server.messer.wtf'; exit 0; }; sleep 2; done; echo 'TIMEOUT — dev server not ready after 90 s (see /Users/jakob/.pm2/logs/messer-swipe-dev-out.log)'; exit 1

stop_commands.title: Stop supervised dev server
stop_commands.description: Delete PM2 apps, free port 3000, drop the dev lock.
stop_commands.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/pm2 delete messer-swipe-dev messer-swipe-dev-watch 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /Users/jakob/Repos/messer-swipe/.next/dev/lock; echo 'dev server stopped — PM2 apps deleted, port 3000 free'
